name: rough-walk-g
description: Velocity-commanded walking trained from scratch on a rough-terrain ladder (3300 iterations): the sturdiest of the family on small stairs and slopes, at +17% motor power over alpha_walking.

twist: vx: forward velocity command, m/s, trained range -0.4 .. 0.4
vy: lateral velocity command, m/s, trained range -0.3 .. 0.3
wz: yaw rate command, rad/s, trained range -1.0 .. 1.0 (achieved ~0.29 at 1.0 — weak turner)
command.head: 4 head-joint deltas from HOME, rad — tracked

training.run: pollen-robotics/hostile-g-continue-c-20260830-0630 (from scratch: 2500 it as hostile-c-scratch-feet-progress-20260830-0209, +800 it continued; wandb lyr06dji -> 4x3786f3)

eval.sim_proxy: CPU MuJoCo with the BAM XL330 servo model; 10 s rollouts at 0.3 m/s, 5 random headings per terrain
eval.battery_falls: 12/110 (alpha_walking: 32/110); the only policy of the family that survived both 2 cm stairs and the 9 deg slope in the synchronized comparison
eval.turn_response: 0.29 rad/s achieved for 1.0 commanded - the weak point
eval.known_limits: +17% motor power vs alpha_walking (warmer servos under sustained use); weak turn response; stalls on rubble bumps >= ~1.5 cm; a completely new gait style, so hardware transfer is less certain than for the fine-tuned policies; never tested on hardware
